letter.content: I am a faithful smoker of your new cigarette, Salem Lights, being a previous smoker of Salem regular, I changed because of the lower tar + nicotine content. But, as I opened a new pack of Lights, I lit up one, and the draw was very light. I noticed the filter tip was fastened unsecurely, allowing air through the passage. Thinking nothing of this, I disposed of it, and lit up another one, but to my dismay the second cigarette was the same way. Your slipping in your inspection department, for there was a third one also in the pack.
